sql_template:
SELECT workclass, fnlwgt, education, educational-num, marital-status, occupation, relationship, race, gender, capital-gain, capital-loss, native-country, income
FROM tabular_data
WHERE age BETWEEN :a_min AND :a_max
  AND hours-per-week BETWEEN :b_min AND :b_max;

full_dataset_summary.reconstruction_note: Only the numeric sensitive columns age and hours-per-week are reconstructed. All remaining columns are shown as returned attributes to make each row description as specific as possible.

subset_summary.sampling_rule: Deterministic best-of-64 support-aware stratified sample on income with seed=7 and provisional grid=8
subset_summary.query_workload_note: Queries are generated in the public integer raw domain first, then mapped onto the hidden 2D grid for REMIN. That means repeated passive queries can still split points inside the same coarse bucket before the final geometry is evaluated in hidden-grid space.

attack_catalog.summary: Learns geometry from repeated multidimensional range-query overlaps and embeds the recovered co-occurrence structure into approximate coordinates.
Uses repeated query identity together with overlap structure to refine a 2D reconstruction once search and access leakage are both available.
Recovers axis order from access-pattern overlaps alone, then turns the recovered ordering into an approximate 2D placement.
Builds a graph from access-pattern co-occurrence and uses graph drawing to approximate the hidden geometry with no explicit search-pattern labels.
Works from search plus token-volume leakage under a linear scheme, using per-axis interval counts to estimate the hidden layout without record-level access.
Uses prefix-style token volumes from a response-hiding scheme to solve for approximate cell occupancies when access patterns are suppressed.

assumptions: query log and access pattern trace are available
passive leakage only; no injection or poisoning
repeated queries reveal a stable search pattern
access pattern reveals stable row handles
the weighted query-response incidence matrix preserves local geometry
notes: This v1 runner is a paper-inspired refinement built on weighted query incidence rather than the original full research code.

assumptions: row-level access patterns still reveal relative order information
order reconstruction is evaluated after symmetry alignment
notes: This v1 runner focuses on order-style reconstruction from access patterns only.

assumptions: graph-layout baseline runs on the same response trace
the scheme leaks per-token interval volumes but not row identities
token-family structure is known to the attacker
query-level volumes can be projected onto a bipartite token graph
notes: This v1 runner is a representative linear-family reconstruction heuristic over token-level volumes.

assumptions: response-hiding leakage exposes token-level prefix volumes
prefix-volume ordering is monotone along each sensitive axis
rectangle totals can be enforced with iterative proportional fitting
notes: This v1 runner approximates the SRC family with prefix-volume ordering and rectangle-mass fitting.
